script: My son's silent scream exposed a family secret that shattered everything.. My 41‑year‑old self is in the middle of a full‑time disaster. My kids are autistic, and every time I try to talk to my 5‑year‑old, I hit a wall that feels like a brick wall. (I know, right?) My 3‑year‑old is heading down the same path, and the "solution" from the system is a "supported community" and a job at a grocery store. Like, seriously? That's the pinnacle of life? I am literally laughing at the audacity of it all. My wife is basically a money‑and‑insurance machine. She's not into me. She's not into us. She's not into the vibe. I am the only guy in the house who has any real value besides a paycheck. (Honestly, that's the worst.) Sex? I've had it once in the last year. It's still a shock, but the shock is fading. I feel my mojo evaporating, and it scares me. I am like, "Where's the energy, dude?" I am losing my spark and I can't even feel it. People? I hate everyone. I am not even sure I like anyone. My in‑law squad—my mother‑in‑law and sister‑in‑law—are two rotten humans who make me want to throw up. The rest of my so‑called family? Same. I am basically a solo act in a circus of bad vibes. I have zero friends. My life is a loop: work, kids, work, kids, rinse, repeat. (I am literally living on autopilot, bestie.) And now I busted my knee. I am freaking out that I might have chronic knee problems forever. I am like, "What's next? AI taking my job? AI taking my life?" The future feels like a horror movie. I am just dumping this whole mess out because I have no one else to vent to IRL. Thanks for listening, you're the only one who gets it.
